symptom: MiniMax H3 holds almost all VRAM at 0/20 Model Initializing; shortening duration and restarting alone do not reliably fix it.
root_cause: Reproduced cacheable VRAM_Debug skipping warm-run cleanup, missing base pre-sampler unload, and dynamic/async/headroom-sensitive stalls. Internal CUDA wait site is not proven.
fix: Base pre-sampling unload + non-cacheable VRAM_Debug + async offload 2, reserve-vram 3, vram-headroom 2 on this RTX 4090. See verified run histories.
prevention: Do not disable async offload in this tested dynamic-VRAM profile. Verify cleanup survives KJNodes updates, regenerate API graphs, and test same-input/new-seed repeats at production resolution. Do not equate short smoke success with native-resolution stability.
